title: Metro System Planning Tool Optimization
features: Optimized DisjointSet with path compression + union-by-size, handling 10,000+ ops in near-constant time, ~100x faster than naive.
Applied Edmonds-Karp (with Breadth-First Search) to calculate maximum passenger flow.
Used Kruskal's algorithm to find Minimum spanning tree (network), cutting network cost by ~20%: capacity and costs
Built a trie-based search system for efficient passenger name O(m) lookup.
Solved scheduling optimization problems for ticket checker hiring with a greedy approach.

title: Search Engine Development
features: Designed a search engine using Hash Maps, Graphs, and Sorting Algorithms.
Implemented graph structures with Breadth-First Search (BFS) and Depth-First Search (DFS) for data traversal.
Used hash tables for efficient data storage and retrieval.
Implemented MergeSort and QuickSort for improved performance.
Combined graphs, hash tables, and sorting algorithms to optimize search processes.
